Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
I am sending today a third instalment of the [Primer](/book/353) with additions, I hope you have had the others safely. I have sent them to you instead of the printers to save further mistakes and will follow them up with the rest

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
